about: Antigravity transcript study (2026-10-20). Structure-only: key names, field numbers, value types, counts and fixed-vocabulary enum values were read from local files by small scripts; no conversation text, paths, titles, ids or other values are reproduced. Paths use placeholders (<uuid>, <n>, <workspace>). Counts move while agents run (two CLI conversations were live during the study).

versionsSeen.notes: Tool vocabulary drifts between CLI language-server versions: older CLI transcripts use view_file/write_to_file with toolAction/toolSummary args; the live 1.4.x conversations observed during the study emitted read_file/write_file calls (args Path/StartLine/EndLine, Content/Overwrite, no toolAction/toolSummary).

findings.topic: Tool call -> result pairing is positional
findings.example: line k: PLANNER_RESPONSE tool_calls=[A,B]; line k+1: result of A; line k+2: result of B
findings.count: CLI (by tool -> type of the next step): view_file -> GENERIC 2,940 / VIEW_FILE 403; run_command -> GENERIC 2,364 / RUN_COMMAND 714; write_to_file -> GENERIC 707 / CODE_ACTION 97; call_mcp_tool -> GENERIC 500 / MCP_TOOL 14; replace_file_content -> GENERIC 355 / CODE_ACTION 128; grep_search -> GREP_SEARCH 153 / GENERIC 31; list_dir -> LIST_DIRECTORY 72 / GENERIC 32; ask_question -> ASK_QUESTION 10 / GENERIC 6. At least 51 of ~8,990 calls (<1%) land on a non-result step (PLANNER_RESPONSE, CHECKPOINT, ERROR_MESSAGE, USER_INPUT, SYSTEM_MESSAGE). Legacy IDE: every call matched its typed result except view_file -> ERROR_MESSAGE 2.
findings.notes: JSONL has no call id (traces.com: 'Antigravity records carry no call id, so Traces pairs each result to the most recent preceding call by step order'). The SQLite db does have one: steps.metadata field 4 = {1: call id like 'xxxx_xxxxxxx', 2: tool name, 3: args JSON} on 7,462 result steps. Result step type is GENERIC for most tools in newer CLI versions; typed results (RUN_COMMAND with exit_code, CODE_ACTION, VIEW_FILE...) in older ones.

findings.topic: Write timing (live tail, 150 s, 2 concurrent CLI conversations, 51 lines)
findings.example: t=8.37 PLANNER_RESPONSE/DONE tools=[run_command] lag_vs_created_at=6.1s; t=9.90 GENERIC/DONE lag=2.6s
findings.count: PLANNER_RESPONSE lines arrived 6-35 s after their created_at; result lines 0.25-2 s after the planner line (or in the same write for batched read_file calls); one GENERIC result arrived 43.6 s after its created_at (long tool)
findings.notes: A step line is appended when the step completes; created_at is the step start. So: model output and thinking are not streamed (nothing appears while the model generates), tool_start is visible as soon as the planner line lands, tool_end when the result line lands. File order is the clock; created_at is not monotonic with write order.

findings.example: transcript.jsonl size grows; first N bytes unchanged; inode unchanged
findings.count: 240 s watch: 35 change events each on transcript.jsonl and transcript_full.jsonl, 33/33 prefix-hash checks unchanged, no shrink, no inode change; transcript.jsonl ended with a newline at all 35 samples; chunks/transcript_full had a partial last line 3/34 times; one earlier read of a transcript.jsonl hit an unterminated last line
findings.notes: Same tail strategy as Claude Code R6: read by byte offset, buffer a trailing partial line. jetbox_summaries_proto.pb is replaced whole (inode changed 2x, shrank once), conversation_summaries.db changed 3x (+WAL), the live conversation .db-wal changed 85x.

findings.example: {"type":"RUN_COMMAND","status":"RUNNING"} with no later line for that step
findings.count: 602 RUNNING lines (GENERIC 452, RUN_COMMAND 151); RUN_COMMAND: exit_code present 540 (DONE), absent 151 (RUNNING) + 27 (DONE); 540 of the RUNNING lines are status DONE in the SQLite db by now
findings.notes: The status is a snapshot taken when the line was written. A RUNNING result means the tool went to the background (run_command with WaitMsBeforeAsync, schedule timers). Completion reaches the agent later as a messages/<uuid>.json notice (sourceMetadata.tool.stepIndex points back to the run_command step) or via command_status / manage_task status calls.

findings.topic: step_index is not unique and not monotonic
findings.example: two different lines with the same step_index
findings.count: 43 step indexes appear twice: 0 byte-identical, 0 same created_at, 42 different type (PLANNER_RESPONSE<->GENERIC 39); 19 backward jumps (11 within 3 lines of a CHECKPOINT, 6 within 3 lines of CONVERSATION_HISTORY); 73 forward gaps
findings.notes: Indexes are renumbered around compaction/history reload, so a repeated index is a NEW step. Never dedupe by step_index; key lines by byte offset (or step_index + created_at).

findings.example: USER_INPUT -> PLANNER_RESPONSE(tool_calls) -> results ... -> PLANNER_RESPONSE(content, no tool_calls) -> [SYSTEM_MESSAGE] -> USER_INPUT
findings.count: first record USER_INPUT in 33/34 files; step before USER_INPUT: PLANNER_RESPONSE with text 158 of 166; after a PLANNER_RESPONSE without tool_calls: SYSTEM_MESSAGE 324, USER_INPUT 160, ERROR_MESSAGE 2, CHECKPOINT 2; last record of a file: PLANNER_RESPONSE with text 28/34
findings.notes: No explicit turn-end record. End of turn = PLANNER_RESPONSE with content and no tool_calls, confirmed by summary status idle (proto field 1.2.5 = 1, db CASCADE_RUN_STATUS_IDLE). planner shapes (content?, thinking?, n tools): (n,n,1) 2,784, (n,y,1) 2,226, (n,y,2) 540, (y,n,0) 404, (n,y,3) 211, (y,y,0) 109, (y,n,1) 131.

findings.example: USER_INPUT.content = "<USER_REQUEST>...</USER_REQUEST><ADDITIONAL_METADATA>...</ADDITIONAL_METADATA>"
findings.count: 201/201 USER_INPUT contents start with '<'; tags: USER_REQUEST 201, ADDITIONAL_METADATA 201, USER_SETTINGS_CHANGE 33, PLAN 26
findings.notes: The human prompt is the inner text of USER_REQUEST. ADDITIONAL_METADATA is environment context and must never be shown. The Claude Code rule 'skip text starting with <' would drop every Antigravity prompt.

mappingHints.session: id = brain dir uuid (== conversations/<uuid>.db stem == summary key; 37/37). agent: 'antigravity'. Discover ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/brain/*/.system_generated/logs/transcript_full.jsonl (fallback transcript.jsonl, also when full is shorter), plus the same glob under ~/.gemini/antigravity-ide and ~/.gemini/antigravity in case a version writes logs there. Ignore conversations/*.pb.
mappingHints.cwdAndProject: Summary proto 1.2.9.1 (file URI -> decode -> path), else history.jsonl latest workspace for that conversationId, else first run_command args.Cwd. Then the shared projectKey() rules (worktree paths). Re-read the proto on mtime change (it is replaced whole).
mappingHints.title: annotations/<uuid>.pbtxt title -> summary 1.2.1 -> inner USER_REQUEST of the first USER_INPUT (<= 40) -> id prefix. Scrub + cap 80.
mappingHints.branch: Summary 1.2.9.4 (matched the repo's current branch in 61/70 checkable cases); null when the workspace is not a git repo (field absent in 22/64 IDE, 6/35 CLI).
mappingHints.prompt: USER_INPUT (source USER_EXPLICIT): text = inner of <USER_REQUEST>...</USER_REQUEST>; never emit ADDITIONAL_METADATA / USER_SETTINGS_CHANGE / PLAN blocks.
mappingHints.toolStart: For each tool_calls[i] of a PLANNER_RESPONSE line: toolUseId = '<conv>:<byteOffset>:<i>' (no call id in jsonl; step_index collides). tool = name. summary from args: view_file/read_file AbsolutePath|Path basename; write_to_file/replace_file_content/multi_replace_file_content TargetFile basename; write_file Path basename; run_command program of CommandLine; grep_search Query; find_by_name Pattern; list_dir DirectoryPath basename; read_url_content Url host; search_web query; call_mcp_tool ServerName + ToolName; schedule DurationSeconds; manage_task Action. In transcript.jsonl JSON.parse each arg string first. toolSummary/toolAction are optional cleaned labels. background: run_command with WaitMsBeforeAsync whose result is RUNNING.
mappingHints.toolEnd: Pair positionally: the next N non-PLANNER lines after the planner line, in file order, are the results of its N calls. ok = status DONE and no error and (RUN_COMMAND exit_code absent or 0); failed = status ERROR or error field or non-zero exit_code; RUNNING result = background launch -> tool_end ok (like R28) and optionally close the background job on a messages/<uuid>.json with matching stepIndex. abandoned = calls still unpaired when a PLANNER_RESPONSE, USER_INPUT, CHECKPOINT or ERROR_MESSAGE line arrives (>= 51 such cases in the corpus).
mappingHints.thinking: PLANNER_RESPONSE.thinking (3,416 lines; truncated in transcript.jsonl, full in transcript_full.jsonl). No duration field; durationMs = null. Optionally show a 'thinking' state between the last result line and the next planner line, since generation is not streamed.
mappingHints.plan: CLI: no task-list source found (manage_task is background-job control, not a plan). IDE: parse brain/<uuid>/task.md checkboxes ([ ] pending, [/] in_progress, [x] completed) on mtime change, source 'tasks'-like; implementation_plan.md could feed an exit_plan-style board via planFromMarkdown.
mappingHints.question: ask_question: question = questions[0].question (+N), options = questions[0].options (<= 4). Ended by its ASK_QUESTION/GENERIC result line (17 calls).
mappingHints.turnEnd: PLANNER_RESPONSE with content and no tool_calls -> end_turn after a quiet period; next USER_INPUT -> next_turn if not ended; summary status 1.2.5 = 1 (idle) can confirm. ERROR_MESSAGE -> system api_error (agent retries), not turn_end.
mappingHints.subagents: None observable locally (all depth 0, no parent ids). Leave isSubagent=false; revisit if INVOKE_SUBAGENT / BROWSER_SUBAGENT lines or parent_conversation_id appear.
mappingHints.errorsDenialsInterrupts: failed from status ERROR / error / exit_code; error text: first line, scrubbed, <= 120. denied: no evidence in jsonl (permission decisions only in SQLite, all granted). interrupted: 1 ERROR_MESSAGE mentions an interrupt; no structural marker. CHECKPOINT -> system kind compact.
mappingHints.liveTailing: Poll every 250 ms by byte offset; buffer partial lines; append-only (no rewrite seen). On attach, scan the whole file in replay mode (R7-like) and key lines by byte offset, never by step_index. A line appears only when its step completes, so tool_start latency = model generation time. Summary proto and annotations are small whole-file rewrites: re-read on mtime/size/inode change.

feasibility: CLI (agy) and the legacy IDE: yes. A zero-dependency Node 20 adapter can follow brain/<uuid>/.system_generated/logs/transcript_full.jsonl (fallback transcript.jsonl) with the same offset tailer as Claude Code, and get title/workspace/branch/status from the plain-protobuf summary file (tiny varint walker, field numbers above) plus annotations pbtxt and history.jsonl. What it needs: positional tool pairing, synthetic tool ids, USER_REQUEST extraction, RUNNING-as-background handling, and tolerance for step_index collisions and new step types. Antigravity 2.x desktop app (~/.gemini/antigravity): not from files today. Its conversations/*.pb look encrypted and are rewritten whole; reading them would need the key and the trajectory schema (neither available). Only brain artifacts (task.md checklist, plans, walkthroughs) and the summary proto (title, workspace, branch, idle/running, step count) are readable, which supports a coarse 'working / idle + plan board' character but no tool events. Alternatives: the per-process local language server (exa.language_server_pb.LanguageServerService on random localhost HTTP/HTTPS ports, ports only in logs, auth unknown) could serve trajectories but is an undocumented API; the CLI SQLite dbs hold the same steps with real tool-call ids but need SQLite (Node >= 22.5 or a dependency).
